reviewer: Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code), at the maintainer's direction
notes: Inspected the 1536x1024 capture from Whole-product QA evidence run 33439159119 at commit cd9fb6c6b38020544da8475ea981bba3586aaa38. Core hierarchy holds: sidebar counts, queue table, and review drawer read as three distinct planes; date-first proposed filenames, right-aligned confidence, and em-dashes for absent values are consistent down the column. Ready, Needs review, Processing, and Waiting are each distinguishable by icon as well as colour, and the automated contrast assertions for the review and waiting statuses passed at 4.5:1 in this same run. Focus and selection are unambiguous - a ring on the filename input, a tint on the row the drawer describes. No clipping, collisions, illegible copy, or excessive density; the filename field's right-edge truncation is an input scrolled to offset zero, which is what the capture test arranges so the head of the proposed name is visible rather than its tail. The capture is byte-identical to the alpha.3 one because nothing in alpha.4 touches the primary screen: the two new intake lines are conditional and live in the Settings dialog, which this capture does not show. Scope is a rendered fidelity review of the web build, not a pixel-equality claim; native title bar, 1024 layout, hover, and motion rely on the automated and installed-app gates, which passed in this run.
